title: Tamsin and the Lantern
author: Zephyrine Crane
blurb: Paloma Almeida, a mapmaker's apprentice finishing the atlas the master died for, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then the census taker asks one question too many — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
